top_choice_rationale: P002 credits a distinct and mature physical idea: Katori's magic-wavelength optical lattice, in which the clock-transition light shift cancels so that thousands of neutral atoms are interrogated in parallel without Doppler or recoil shifts, together with Ye's realisation of the 10^-18 regime. It has been reproduced at several national laboratories, the two-name allocation maps onto concept and realisation without a named omission, and a citation anchored on the lattice concept and the 10^-18 demonstration stays clear of the comb and ion-clock lineages honoured in 2005 and 2012. P001 is a close second with the longest confirmation record, but its allocation leaves out Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang, who proposed the HgTe route, and that cannot be repaired later. P003 is scientifically important but the pairing mechanism is open, the decisive experiments are recent, and the experimental credit omits Cao and others. Some award is better than none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented collaborators (L'Huillier, Lund and Keller attosecond groups, Schuch, Dahlstrom, Argenti, Indelicato) are not credited on any proposal, and my AMO background is an affinity, not a conflict
